ShortDescription.Value: Create custom bridges from available roads and tracks, with 3D previews and supported double-deck styles.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Bridge Builder
## English
Bridge Builder combines available roads or tracks with supported bridge styles in Cities: Skylines II. Choose a network and bridge style, inspect the live 3D preview, then save your bridge or place it with the game's network construction tool.
### Features
- 37 registered bridge styles, including fixed suspension, cable-stayed, arch, viaduct and covered designs, depending on the selected source content. - GO 224m Viaduct Bridge, Nanpu Bridge and Lupu Bridge styles from their respective source mods. - Custom movable bridges: drawbridges, lift bridges and pedestrian movable styles from Bridges & Ports. - Independent upper and lower roads or tracks on supported double-deck styles, including opposite deck directions. - Search and filter networks and bridge styles. Use Create to save a bridge, or Create and build to enter construction mode when it is unlocked. - Preview, rename, export, build and delete saved bridges from the management panel. - Continuous asynchronous preview generation and viewport-sized rendering with antialiasing. Actual waiting time depends on the selected content and hardware. - Native-material-based shaders with current-skeleton binding for supported movable surfaces and decals, with owner-local persisted dependencies. - A multilingual interface and configurable shortcut (Ctrl+B by default). Bridges normally inherit their source unlock requirements; the settings can bypass development-point restrictions.
### Compatibility
Bridge styles become available when every source registered for that style is installed, enabled and natively available. Missing content hides only the affected styles.
Bridges & Ports DLC is not required to use Bridge Builder. Only bridge styles that use its content require it.
These integrations are optional; select only content you use.
**Network creation**
- [Road Builder](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/87190/Windows) - [Street Studio Public V2](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/165677/Windows)
**Bridge content**
- [Bridge Expansion Pack](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/92245/Windows) - [GO 224m Viaduct Bridge](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/166012/Windows) - [Shanghai Nanpu Bridge](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/162995/Windows) - [Lupu Bridge](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/151335/Windows)
The exact published source titles of the last two listings are `上海南浦大桥` (Shanghai Nanpu Bridge) and `卢浦大桥` (Lupu Bridge). These literal source names identify the linked assets; the descriptions here are English.
Bridge Expansion Pack supplies Truss Viaduct, double-deck Suspension, Art Deco Viaduct and double-deck Golden Gate styles. Art Deco Viaduct and double-deck Golden Gate also require San Francisco Set DLC. [Bridge Expansion Pack: B&P](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/124160/Windows) remains optional compatible content, not a registered prerequisite for these 37 styles.
**Bridge generation**
- [Bridge Engineer](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/164700/Windows)
**Node editing**
- [Node Controller](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/138523/Windows)
### Notes
Follow Street Studio’s own guidance: disable Road Builder when using its independent fork.
Install the game/DLC and optional mod content required by the roads or supported bridge styles you select. The double-deck Golden Gate style comes from Bridge Expansion Pack, not the base single-deck Golden Gate prototype.
Keep Bridge Builder installed and enabled. Mod-owned precompiled material programs require its startup registration; operation after disabling or uninstalling the mod is not supported. Required game/DLC and third-party material resources remain prerequisites, including virtual textures. A resource available on the author's machine is not necessarily installed on every player's machine. Saved bridges have their own dependency snapshots; updating the mod does not regenerate their geometry.
There is no reliable fully automatic importer for arbitrary custom bridge assets. Supporting a new style requires bridge-specific measurements, implementation and visual checks. A coding agent does not guarantee a correct result in one attempt. See [Adding a bridge style with a coding agent](https://github.com/Chengxuan-He/CS2BridgeBuilder#adding-a-bridge-style-with-a-coding-agent). Compatibility with every third-party asset or network/style combination is not promised.
- Back up your city before removing a bridge. **Deleting a generated bridge also removes its placed instances.** - If a self-check reports changes and requests a restart, restart the game before continuing. - Recreate older bridges affected by a generation fix when needed; preserve unaffected bridges and back up your save first. - Report the game/mod versions, bridge style, selected networks, screenshots and relevant logs when something goes wrong. Rendering and motion can require further verification for particular combinations.
Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/Chengxuan-He/CS2BridgeBuilder). Original project code is MIT-licensed; game and third-party assets retain their respective licenses.
